steps.en: Install the menu-bar app (drag the .dmg) or the Homebrew formula
steps.zh: 安装菜单栏应用（拖 .dmg）或 Homebrew 包

steps.en: Start the server pointed at your folder of MLX models
steps.zh: 把服务器指向你的 MLX 模型目录并启动

steps.en: Auto-discovers LLMs, VLMs, embeddings and rerankers in the folder and keeps them loaded under a memory cap
steps.zh: 自动发现目录里的各类模型，在内存上限内保持加载

steps.en: Point your coding agent or any OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible client at it
steps.zh: 把编码 agent 或任何 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容客户端指向它

steps.en: Continuously batches requests, keeping the KV cache hot in RAM and cold on SSD across restarts
steps.zh: 连续批处理请求，KV 缓存热在内存、冷在 SSD，扛得住重启

value.en: Long-context coding-agent sessions on local Mac models without per-token API bills or babysitting a terminal
value.zh: 在本地 Mac 模型上跑长上下文编码 agent 会话，既不必按 token 付费，也不用守着终端

sources: README.md main @ 2026-09 (raw.githubusercontent.com/jundot/omlx/main/README.md): brew tap jundot/omlx https://github.com/jundot/omlx; brew install jundot/omlx/omlx; omlx serve --model-dir ~/models; discovers LLMs, VLMs, embedding models, and rerankers automatically; OpenAI-compatible client connects at http://localhost:8000/v1; tiered hot-RAM/cold-SSD KV cache surviving restarts; continuous batching via mlx-lm BatchGenerator; EnginePool in the architecture diagram
